name: Oidemase, Kokuri-san
original_name: おいでませ、こくりさん
source:
“Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please come see us.”

When you fearlessly chant the “Kokkuri-san” spell at school in the middle of the night, what appeared was a surprisingly cute little fox named Kurune Kokuri.

And so begins the investigation of the Seven Wonders of School by you and Kurune Kokuri…

[from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2022/11/vtuber-kurune-kokuri-visual-novel-welcome-kokuri-san-announced-for-ps4-switch-pc-ios-and-android]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
“库库里先生，库库里先生，请来看我们。”

半夜，当你在学校无所畏惧地念出“小栗同学”咒语时，出现的竟然是一只可爱得令人惊讶的小狐狸，名叫小栗栗。

你和小栗旬对学园七大奇迹的调查就这样开始了……

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2022/11/vtuber-kurune-kokuri-visual-novel-welcome-kokuri-san-announced-for-ps4-switch-pc-ios-and-android]Gematsu[/url]]
